shortDescription: Upload, update or delete an Auto Certificate in the IONOS CLOUD Certificate Manager.

options.name: allow_replace
options.description: Boolean indicating if the resource should be recreated when the state cannot be reached in another way. This may be used to prevent resources from being deleted from specifying a different value to an immutable property. An error will be thrown instead

options.name: certificate_name
options.description: A certificate name used for management purposes.

options.name: common_name
options.description: The common name (DNS) of the certificate to issue. The common name needs to be part of a zone in IONOS CLOUD DNS.

options.name: key_algorithm
options.description: The key algorithm used to generate the certificate.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: provider
options.description: The certificate provider used to issue the certificates.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: subject_alternative_names
options.description: Optional additional names to be added to the issued certificate. The additional names need to be part of a zone in IONOS CLOUD DNS.

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
